description: Turn timesheet entries into invoice JSON. $0.02 USDC on Base per call. Hours x rate, optional rounding, grouping, expenses, tax and terms become a validated invoice JSON with totals, ready for /v1/invoice.pdf. Don't use this for the PDF itself; send the result to /v1/invoice.pdf. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: paidpilot_invoice_from_timesheet
title: PaidPilot Invoice API: POST /v1/invoice-from-timesheet
